_comment: PLACEHOLDER until open question Q5 is answered: replace with one real Zerodha F&O contract note dated on or after 2026-04-01 (STT 0.15%).
orders: one row per executed order on the note: side BUY|SELL, filled_qty in units, value = sum of price x qty of its trades, external_kind null (or AUTO_SQUAREOFF for a broker square-off order).

charges: the note's totals for those orders. brokerage = taxable value of supply (brokerage); txn = exchange transaction charges; gst = CGST + SGST + IGST; stt = securities transaction tax; sebi = SEBI turnover fees; stamp = stamp duty; ipft and sqoff_fee as printed (0 if absent).

Then set placeholder to false. tests/unit/test_charges.py::test_contract_note_fixture compares charges.net_pnl with these lines, within tolerance_rs_per_order per order (the CHARGES_DRIFT threshold); a failure means a new RateSet is needed.
